user_query: What's the difference between FHA and conventional loans?
copilot_response: FHA loans require lower down payments (3.5% minimum) compared to conventional loans which typically need 20%. FHA loans have mortgage insurance that lasts for the life of the loan. Conventional loans may have PMI that can be removed. FHA loans have lower credit score requirements. Conventional loans often have better rates for qualified borrowers. FHA loans have property condition requirements. Conventional loans are more flexible. Both have different debt-to-income requirements. The choice depends on your financial situation.
